title: Char Siu Tofu Stir Fry
description: A classic Chinese-inspired dish made with char siu-glazed tofu, served with a side of steamed vegetables.

ingredients.name: Siu Sauce ingredients: hoisin sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar

instructions: Heat 1 tsp of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped scallions and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the char siu-glazed tofu and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to brown.
Add the chopped bok choy and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until it starts to wilt.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
